'''Durro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who was one of the younger Tangan brothers, the owners of the company [[Tangan Industries]]. He was married to the [[Near-Human]] [[Elexia Nis'tar]] and around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Tangan Industries appointed Nis'tar to act as the [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Haven (city)|Haven]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Iol]]. Nis'tar prioritized the interests of the planet's colonists over those of Tangan during her tenure, which earned her the favor of Durro.<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />
